data.summary:
Dynamic & results-oriented professional, pursuing opportunities to apply extensive expertise in fund accounting and financial analysis, drawing on experience in managing global trade processing, electronic trade delivery (SWIFT) and multi-asset settlements across diverse financial landscapes.
❖ Possess nearly 8 years of experience, concentrating on fund accounting, trade processing, and financial analysis, while navigating both
domestic and international market dynamics.
❖ Developed a skill set in trade validation and corporate actions, gaining expertise in electronic trade delivery and multi-asset settlements. ❖ Realized gains in operational efficiency through optimization of trade processing workflow, which led to a marked decrease in discrepancies
and a substantial enhancement in the accuracy of financial reporting.
❖ Exhibited strong leadership skills by guiding and training junior team members, cultivating a supportive team atmosphere that encourages
professional development and collective success.
❖ Possess a thorough comprehension of custody and accounting reconciliation process, guaranteeing that all financial records are accurately
maintained and adhere to industry compliance standards.
❖ Proficient in leveraging advanced financial modeling and data analysis tools to drive strategic decision-making, ensuring that financial
forecasts are both accurate and actionable, which enhances overall business performance.
❖ Recognized for exceptional analytical skills, delivering insights that inform investment strategies and enhance portfolio performance,
contributing to a financial decision-making framework.
❖ Actively engaged in continuous professional development, staying up-to-date of industry trends and regulatory changes, which ensures
compliance and positions the organization as a leader in financial services.
